basics.name: Dr. Sagar Hosangadi Prutvi
basics.label: Data Scientist | Research Engineer
basics.summary:
Welcome to my online portfolio!
I am currently a Post-Doctoral researcher at Universität Freiburg.
I hold an engineering Ph.D., from the prestigious Indian Institute of Technology Bombay (IIT-B) and bring rich expertise in the fascinating field of Tribo-electric Nanogenerators (TENG) and electromechanical devices.

Along with a wealth of Research & Development activities, I have 7 years of professional experience. My diverse skill set encompass Data Science, Mechanical, Electrical and Electronics engineering , as well as proficient coding abilities. These enable me to tackle intricate multidisciplinary challenges with finesse.

Explore my portfolio to see my work in action. If any of my skills, projects or expertise resonate with you,
let's connect, collaborate, and create something remarkable together.

work.summary: Developing frequency tunable triboelectric energy harvesters
highlights: Designed novel Frequency tunable triboelectric energy harvesting design using micro fluidic principles

Led end-to-end development of sensing systems spanning novel harvestor design, experimental setup, signal acquisition, algorithm development, validation, and performance benchmarking under real-world conditions.
Built custom data acquisition and annotation platforms using PyQt, enabling synchronized multi-instrument experiments, scalable dataset creation, and reproducible labeling workflows.
Designed and validated signal processing and detection algorithms on noisy, real-world sensor data, including systematic analysis of edge cases, failure modes, and environmental variability.
Developed novel signal characteristics and measures to evaluate the shape change of tribo electric signals, enabling more robust and accurate detection of events.

work.summary: Co/developing RAG based contract intelligence system
highlights: Built a reusable clause library tool for maintaining, reviewing, and updating contract clauses using RAG architecture with OpenAI & Langchain in Streamlit.
Led development of context aware RAG POC for reliable contract intelligence.
Translated ambiguous business requirements into deployable GenAI workflows.

work.summary: Worked as an A.V.P. to implement Data science initiatives for process improvements
highlights: Designed and developed an end-to-end client ranking solution to automate the auditing process, reducing operational duration from months to hours using Pyspark in Palantir Foundry.
Generating analytical & data science solutions to enhance processes and guide business decisions.
Consulted on data science projects like Risk modelling for claims and TA team

work.summary: Data Science Services group - Landmark division
highlights: Translating business needs into Data Science problem statements.
Led group of 4-5 data scientists to deliver data science solutions for various business units.
Developed Application computetime prediction model for survey data, combining both structured and unstructured logs, with more than 95% accuracy for cost optimisation
Developed NLP based productive time/non productive time classification model based on field logs, achieving more than 90% accuracy, with dockerised implementation to optimize field operations.
Submitted 2 patent applications to predict drilling performance using novel triboelectric sensors
Developed various Machine learning models (Regression/classification/NLP/anamoly detection/failure prediction).
Developed cost optimization framework for data science initiatives.
Supporting company outreach activities by preparing technical abstracts for conferences.
Mentoring junior data scientists and interns.

work.summary: Translated the designers idea into an engineered product
highlights: Majorly contributed to the designing of small-scale wind turbine (Zeintein).
Technical analysis of mechanisms and their kinetics.
Translating rough sketches into CAD models for engineering analysis.
Complete ownership of small scale wind turbines.

work.summary: Technical analysis for a leg prosthetic
highlights: Created pivotal documents for fund raising and outreach activities.
Performed GAIT analysis, static, dynamic and failure analysis of KAFO (knee Foot Ankle Orthosis) using 3D CAD and FEA.
Actively involved in design optimization by utilizing DFx concepts (manufacturability, assembly and end-use).

work.summary: Here, my majority of the responsibilities were:
highlights: Providing CAD Support in the product development activities of Ion Implanters (client: Varian Semiconductor Equipments).
Creating engineering drawings for sheetmetal parts, solid parts and electrical harnesses.

Electrical harness were major area of focus, where i took complete ownership of schematic drawing, routing path optimization, wiring optimization and developing flatboard/nailboard drawings for final assembly.
